"3D horror game. You are Elias, a dead man trapped in his own memory trying to survive a fatal car crash. Mechanic: gravity shifts when you blink, and objects leave glowing sonic echoes. An invisible entity hunts you by consuming your past footprints. Reach the archive to accept the truth and escape from him.


---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Memory Objective
Wake beside the wreck.
SHARDS 0 / 3
FOOTPRINTS EATEN 0
GRAVITY DOWN
Sanity100%
He is near—
◉
BLINK / SPACE
A 3D horror memory · Crouton Alpha

ELIAS

You are Elias — dead, in the last second of a fatal crash, trapped inside your own memory.
An invisible entity hunts you by eating your past footprints. Reach the Archive, accept the truth, and get out of his reach.

Blink = gravity flipsPress SPACE. Your eyelid closes and you fall to the ceiling-world (or back). Some shards only exist up there.
Sonic echoesObjects constantly ring out glowing echoes. Press F for a sonar ping — it reveals the invisible hunter and your footprints.
Footprints feed himEvery step leaves a glowing footprint. He follows and consumes them, growing faster. Running is loud. Standing still is safest — until he learns where you stopped.
GoalCollect 3 memory shards, unlock the Archive in the north-east, press E and accept what really happened.
WASD move · MOUSE look · SHIFT run · SPACE blink · F sonar · E interact  |  Touch: joystick + buttons
Memory loop

HE ATE
YOUR LAST STEP

Darkness takes the shape of feet that are no longer yours.

The Archive

THE TRUTH

PAUSED

The memory holds its breath.

python3 - << 'PY'
import re
html=open('index.html').read()
# extract map rows for verification
g=re.search(r'const GROUND = \[(.*?)\]',html,re.S).group(1)
c=re.search(r'const CEIL = \[(.*?)\]',html,re.S).group(1)
rows_g=re.findall(r'"(.*)"',g); rows_c=re.findall(r'"(.*)"',c)
print("GROUND rows:",len(rows_g), "widths:", set(len(r) for r in rows_g))
print("CEIL rows:",len(rows_c), "widths:", set(len(r) for r in rows_c))
# render overlap ascii
print("Overlap (both open) map: . = walkable both, g=ground only, c=ceil only, #=wall")
for r in range(13):
  line=""
  for cc in range(13):
    go=rows_g[r][cc]!='#'; co=rows_c[r][cc]!='#'
    line += '.' if go and co else ('g' if go else ('c' if co else '#'))
  print(line)
# shards/archive passability check
def cell(m,c,r): return m[r][c]
for name,m in [('G',rows_g),('C',rows_c)]:
  for ch in 'S123A':
    for r in range(13):
      for cc in range(13):
        if m[r][cc]==ch: print(f"{name} layer {ch} at ({cc},{r}) present")
PY
